detectors.PSI_ONLY: Threshold on psi_full_avg10 fitted on training episodes to meet >=95% BAD-state recall with the highest feasible threshold.
detectors.MULTI_SIGNAL: Equal-weight normalized pressure-risk score across all frozen early-observable features; threshold fitted using the same recall rule.

nonclaims: Feature distributions are synthetic and are not measurements of Linux PSI, swap, reclaim, or refault behavior
The detector is not a production classifier
The latent BAD label is synthetic ground truth available only for harness validation
No live process receives a signal
The synthetic semantic-cost delta is not a user utility estimate
